cohort: 50 pregnant women with SPE complicated with HELLP syndrome and 50 pregnant women with preeclampsia (PE)
finding: SPE complicated with HELLP syndrome has significantly increased adverse pregnancy outcomes and gestational age at onset and gestational age at termination of pregnancy are independent risk factors for its occurrence.
mod_finding: The majority of women with severe preeclampsia complicated with HELLP syndrome in this study underwent cesarean section (96%).
